text:
maria: kicking off preflight for tenant_metadata migration scheduled 02:00 UTC. will run small canary (1% traffic) then staged backfill. tagging @sam @raj for DBA review and @deploy-bot to pin releases :eyes:
deploy-bot: Preflight checks started: schema-compat, replica_lag, long_tx_watch. ETA ~90s.
sam: quick glance - the ALTER adds a jsonb column + backfill. backfill will run in batches (1000/tx) via job queue. rate limit set to 2000 rows/min by default.
raj: noted. can we lower to 800 rows/min for first hour? last night spikes hit 2.5k qps on writes, want conservative start.
maria: agree. canary at 1% with 800 rows/min, monitor for 30m then bump to 10% if stable. rollback criteria: replica_lag > 30s OR p99 write latency +40% OR >5% error rate on write path.
jen: adding release pin: app-service v2.14.3 -> pin to v2.14.2 for canary if anything looks off. ops-bot: created release pin ticket #ENG-1529.
alex: what about KV cache/redis invalidation? backfill will write the new column but we still read old field. plan: double-read fallback for 48h, feature flag gated.
maria: yes double-read behind ff. feature flag name tenant_metadata_v2. will default off for 2% then ramp.
sam: DB checklist: 
```
- confirm replicas caught up
- set apply_batch_size=1000
- set backfill_rate=800
- enable row_guard on hot partitions
- run analyze after chunk
```
raj: also add kill-switch SQL: 
```
-- escape hatch: pause backfill jobs
UPDATE migration_jobs SET paused = true WHERE migration = 'tenant_metadata_v2';
```
jen: put that in runbook and assign oncall as primary for the window. oncall = @raj tonight.
raj: i'll be oncall and watching replication + lock contention. will escalate to DB lead if locks > 5s across >3 hosts.
maria: metrics to watch: replica_lag, p99_write_latency, write_error_rate, index_build_progress, connection_count. dashboards linked: https://graf.redwood/internal/d/tenant-migration
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 02:00:00 UTC. Canary window 02:00-02:30 UTC. Auto-rollback rule: any of the alert rules above -> rollback.
jen: release notes snippet for customers: "Small schema change to tenant metadata to support richer feature flags. Migration performed with staged rollout and no expected downtime. Contact support if you see errors." I'll push before canary.
maria: one more - please ensure migration job binary is pinned to image: ghcr.redwood/infra/migration-runner:2026-03-21-rc1.jen: added to release notes and infra-pins doc.
ops-bot: runbook created: https://confluence.redwood/ops/tenant-metadata-migration-runbook. Assigned: raj (owner), maria (backup), sam (DB advisor).
sam: minor nit - in canary we should skip partitions older than 2020 to avoid heavy compaction. will add filter.
raj: acknowledged. i'll keep a watch on row level locks and increase backoff if lock wait > 200ms.
maria: ack. schedule looks good. i'll post a short reminder 30m before. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary started (1% traffic). preflight checks green.
sam: observed small spike in write locks during first chunk, but within acceptable. lowering concurrency to 4 for the job workers.
alex: feature flag toggled to 2% for canary. double-read enabled.
raj: replica lag stable ~1.2s, p99 write +8%. continuing.
maria: 30m mark approaching. if all good, increment to 10% and bump backfill_rate to 1500 rows/min.
jen: reminder posted to #customer-notifications about expected minor background work.
ops-bot: Alert: p99_write_latency crossed threshold at 02:22 UTC (30% above baseline). Triggering alert workflow.
raj: seeing the p99 spike correlates with heavy compaction on partition 2023-11. pausing backfill for that partition, resuming others.
maria: hold ramp. keep canary at 1% until we confirm compaction finishes.
sam: paused jobs for partition 2023-11, adjusted backoff. I'll re-run analyze and resume when stable.
alex: rolling back feature flag ramp, leaving FF at 2%.
jen: marking incident in notes. no customer impact reported.
raj: compaction finished, locks normalized. replica lag back to 1.1s. p99 back to +5%.
maria: OK to proceed with 10% and 1500 rows/min. proceeding in 2m.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic bumped to 10%. backfill_rate updated via config to 1500 rows/min.
ops-bot: Patch deploy pinned at app-service v2.14.2 for canary fallback.
jen: leaving release pin for 1h post-ramp.
alex: monitoring cache hit rate - no regressions.
raj: final check: no locks > 2s, connection count steady. green.
maria: rolling out to full traffic in staged waves: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m quiet windows. will monitor.
sam: backfill job configured to skip retired partitions and has backpressure.
deploy-bot: Staged rollout started. next wave in 10m.
jen: final: runbook updated with rollback SQL, release pin detail, and incident contact. closing this thread once 100% done. thanks everyone. :party:
